creation.summary: Decide whether this plan owns P0-P3 only or also the future removal of BMAD in P4.
creation.decision: Keep P0-P3 in this plan and make P4 a separately authorized future plan after backend neutrality is proven.

creation.summary: Decide the first adoption and migration scope for implementation-contract.v1.json.
creation.decision: Require it for this new VDD plan and future VDD plans, then pilot one approved non-protected slice; do not retrofit every historical execution plan in the first rollout.

creation.summary: Decide the durable ownership split for the standard, schema, adapter, and per-plan instance.
creation.decision: Own durable policy in docs/standards, protocol/schema/runtime tooling in the repository-owned adapter Skill, and only the instance plus plan-specific predicates inside each execution-plan directory; require an accepted ADR before implementation changes workflow authority.

creation.summary: Decide how the first implementation backend handles stock BMAD Quick Dev, which currently reviews, marks done, and commits.
creation.decision: Use a repository-owned capsule executor as backend v1 and keep BMAD Quick Dev optional until an official implementation-only entry exists; never invoke the stock end-to-end workflow as an authoritative backend.

creation.summary: Decide whether the first adapter release modifies the existing Bootstrap CLI or consumes its current extension points.
creation.decision: Do not modify the 7-12 Bootstrap CLI initially; bind TDD evidence through existing scope, context-class, preflight, and required-check contracts, and open an explicit delta only if executable evidence proves a missing capability.

creation.summary: Decide whether the requested confidence score can authorize plan or implementation state.
creation.decision: Keep the score advisory, allow at most three internal improvement rounds below 90, and let only machine validation authorize plan-ready or implementation-accepted.

creation.summary: Decide the durable custody of the currently untracked agentbuild.txt intent source.
creation.decision: Preserve agentbuild.txt byte-for-byte as original source history, hash-bind it from 98/99, include it in the eventual plan commit, and do not create a duplicate source copy inside the plan.

creation.summary: Decide how executable commands are represented in implementation contracts.
creation.decision: Use stable command IDs plus structured argv, cwd, timeout, expected exit semantics, and expected failure IDs; resolve them through a repository-owned registry and forbid arbitrary raw shell strings.

creation.summary: Decide how baseline and candidate identity work with a dirty Windows worktree.
creation.decision: Do not require or create commits; freeze HEAD plus tracked diff, untracked manifest, relevant file hashes, plan/source/contract/validator/test hashes, reject overlap with pre-existing user edits, and never let the backend commit.

creation.summary: Decide the backfill and canary order for the three existing refactor plans.
creation.decision: Self-host the new plan first, then backfill 7-12 as the validator-rich canary, 7-07 next, and 7-11 last because it depends on 7-07; backfill must not authorize implementation or remove paused states.

creation.summary: Decide whether adapter v1 launches external implementation processes or remains an explicit in-session protocol.
creation.decision: Keep v1 in-session and stateless: prepare and validate a Slice Capsule, enforce write/evidence boundaries, and consume a candidate response without spawning provider or Codex subprocesses; automate launch only through a later explicit delta.

creation.summary: Decide the exact predicate and authority ladder exposed by each plan-local validator.
creation.decision: Support plan-ready, slice-ready, implementation-candidate, and implementation-accepted; candidate authorizes Bootstrap review only, accepted requires current deterministic evidence plus a finalized Bootstrap result with no accepted P0/P1, and none of these predicates authorizes release.

creation.summary: Define what read-only backfill means when each old plan must own a contract instance.
creation.decision: Treat it as additive metadata backfill: add only contract instance and shadow-fixture files to each old plan, leave existing books, status, validators, and historical evidence byte-unchanged, and keep all shadow results non-authoritative.

creation.summary: Define the evidence-based recovery state and storage boundary for adapter runs.
creation.decision: Use append-only logs/tdd-adapter/<plan-id>/<slice-id>/<run-id>/ state and evidence, record predecessor and supersession lineage, resume only when all bound hashes match, and create a new stale-linked run after drift.

creation.summary: Define which P2 dispositions satisfy implementation-accepted.
creation.decision: Require every accepted P2 to be fixed with fresh evidence or explicitly deferred with owner, non-impact proof, expiry or recheck trigger, and exact closure test; open or unowned P2 blocks acceptance.

creation.summary: Define exactly which concurrent Git drift blocks a run.
creation.decision: Block any Git index drift, any authority/contract/validator/command-registry hash drift, and any write-set overlap; record and allow unrelated worktree drift outside those sets.

creation.summary: Resolve current-plan evidence ownership against the repository rule that runtime evidence belongs under logs.
creation.decision: Let each execution-plan own evidence schemas, fixtures, predicates, expected evidence intent, and immutable references, while logs owns append-only run evidence and result envelopes; never store mutable runtime state in the plan directory.

repair.summary: Confirm whether the repair is limited to the named execution-plan directory and its version-controlled plan artifacts.
repair.decision: Repair the complete named directory, but do not modify Bootstrap policy, Phase protected paths, product code, or historical evidence in this change.

repair.summary: Confirm how the Round 3 hard-limit disposition is represented after repair.
repair.decision: Represent the plan as blocked by a hash-bound manual-pause disposition and fail closed for plan-ready and all implementation predicates until a new external policy decision supersedes it.

repair.summary: Confirm the candidate, Bootstrap review, and acceptance sequence.
repair.decision: Make S2 lifecycle-only, make S6 finalize the current implementation candidate without consuming Bootstrap output, run Bootstrap externally, and let S7 consume the bound candidate and finalized review for implementation acceptance.

repair.summary: Confirm how ignored clarification and repair evidence becomes reproducible from a clean checkout.
repair.decision: Add minimized immutable version-controlled projections for clarification decisions and protected shadow baselines while retaining raw logs as append-only historical evidence outside the plan authority chain.

repair.summary: Confirm the repair acceptance boundary and final status claim.
repair.decision: Require composite, unit, schema, mutation, explicit slice-evidence, and clean-checkout validation, but retain blocked/manual-pause status and make no semantic-closure or implementation-authorization claim.

repair_20260717.summary: Confirm the authority treatment for stabilized but uncommitted upstream bytes.
repair_20260717.decision: Use the current upstream bytes for repair discovery and hash binding, but keep their commit ownership outside the 7-15 repair and require an authority commit or equivalent clean snapshot for clean-checkout proof.

repair_20260717.summary: Choose requirement identities for persisted context and attempt lineage.
repair_20260717.decision: Add RMAP-025 and RMAP-026 with S1 schema support, S2 ownership of runtime behavior, and S6 support for final binding.

repair_20260717.summary: Choose capsule revision and predecessor semantics.
repair_20260717.decision: Create one immutable context capsule revision per backend invocation, link later revisions by predecessor capsule hash, and never overwrite a capsule as stage evidence changes.

repair_20260717.summary: Define minimized backend request and response persistence.
repair_20260717.decision: Persist normalized minimized envelopes and raw hashes only; prohibit secrets, personal data, and unauthorized raw request or response bodies.

repair_20260717.summary: Define adapter-decision authority and accepted-candidate ownership.
repair_20260717.decision: Adapter decisions are non-authorizing observations consumed by deterministic stage predicates; accepted_candidate belongs only to S6 candidate finalization.

repair_20260717.summary: Define attempt ordering, partial failure, retry, and stage uniqueness.
repair_20260717.decision: Use monotonic attempt sequence, predecessor decision hash, decision-last finalization, fail-closed partial attempts, and exactly one accepted lineage per represented stage.

repair_20260717.summary: Confirm the repair remains inside the existing architecture boundary.
repair_20260717.decision: Do not add a Router, S8, Phase service changes, 7-12 CLI changes, or historical evidence rewrites.

repair_20260717_999.summary: Define the final candidate changed-file manifest as an independently recomputed cumulative fact.
repair_20260717_999.decision: Use a versioned cumulative candidate diff manifest derived from the frozen baseline and current scoped tracked plus untracked worktree, with exact path, status, byte hashes, roles, identity, and root-hash equality.

repair_20260717_999.summary: Define how the final candidate diff relates to the append-only accepted attempt lineage.
repair_20260717_999.decision: Fold accepted RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR attempt effects by path from baseline to final state and require exact equality with the independently recomputed candidate manifest.

repair_20260717_999.summary: Freeze deterministic rename and test-patch behavior on Windows.
repair_20260717_999.decision: Disable rename inference, represent renames as delete plus add, and derive one binary-safe test patch from the same cumulative manifest.

repair_20260717_999.summary: Freeze the S7 reference to one explicit S6 candidate run without sharing implicit run IDs.
repair_20260717_999.decision: Keep S6 and S7 run IDs independent and bind one non-superseded S6 candidate by path, bytes, candidate hash, predicate, and run ID.

repair_20260717_999.summary: Remove volatile current-state prose that becomes stale after unrelated commits.
repair_20260717_999.decision: Use immutable historical repair revisions, run-scoped observations, and deterministic semantic projection rules instead of a mutable current HEAD claim.

repair_20260717_999.summary: Align the S0 observed RED and narrow ADR-0041 ownership language.
repair_20260717_999.decision: Keep duplicate ownership as the S0 observed RED, ADR collision as a separate negative fixture, and limit ADR-0041 to the shared ownership pattern and Bootstrap execution boundary.

repair_20260717_999.summary: Preserve manual-pause authority during deterministic repair and define later re-entry.
repair_20260717_999.decision: Keep the blocker byte-stable; require a later durable policy revision, new authority cycle, and independent semantic closure before requesting plan-ready.

repair_20260717_1200.decision: Add machine successor and S0-S6 lineage contracts.
Bind recovery, event, and successor evidence.
Remove static future finding IDs from the plan contract.
Use disposable Git repositories and reparse guards.

non_goals: No product or Phase protected-path implementation is authorized by this projection.
No Bootstrap round or semantic closure is authorized by this projection.
Raw conversations and personal data are excluded.
